scores.rationale: Cased 1979 Wyndham Estate PM port, 4 bottles; novelty commemorative, modest market, roughly $50-100.
Three common Australian mantel radios, cracked and dirty and untested; roughly $60-120 together.
Box of common 1960s-70s transistor radios; Sanyo Transcontinental adds some value but the rest is low, roughly $60-100.
Mixed kitchen tins, rusty canisters with some Art Nouveau appeal; roughly $50-100.
Racebooks with years unknown and aged condition; likely mostly later issues, roughly $30-70.
Mixed Launceston prints; one signed watercolour and an Atlas engraving but modest values, roughly $60-120.
Ten Murano uranium glass pieces with dolphin-stem coupes; decent collector appeal, roughly $150-300.
Seven mid-late 20th century Shiwan figures, likely losses; roughly $20-40 each, $120-200 as a group.
Vanity Fair Spy prints with unknown quantity and originality; mix of originals and reproductions, roughly $80-200.
Loose, incomplete 1980s G.I. Joe parts and common die-cast; roughly $60-120.
